    <meta name="description" content="New Zealand Defence Force | 78,129 followers on LinkedIn. Te Ope Kātua O Aotearoa | New Zealand Defence Force |
Home of the Navy Army and Air Force | A Force for New Zealand | Every hour of the day, 365 days a year, we protect New Zealand’s interests at sea, safeguard peace and stability within our neighbouring regions and further afield, and help others in times of need with agile air operations across the world.

Our core task is to conduct military operations and be combat capable, ready to protect the sovereign territory of New Zealand and any areas under our responsibility, including the preparedness, protection and preservation of people, property and information.

Although we are prepared for combat, our technical skills, professional training, and high-end military equipment mean we can partner with other agencies towards a range of domestic and international challenges, including search and rescue, disaster relief, counter-terrorism and maritime surveillance.">

    <p class="attributed-text-segment-list__content text-color-text !text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap break-words
        " dir="ltr" data-test-id="main-feed-activity-card__commentary">Academic achievements 🎓 Four Royal New Zealand Air Force personnel have gained Bachelor of Applied Management degrees through the <a class="link" href="https://nz.linkedin.com/school/open-polytechnic-of-new-zealand/?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" target="_self" data-tracking-control-name="organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" data-tracking-will-navigate>Open Polytechnic of New Zealand</a>, and celebrated their graduation at the place where most of them spent time training in their early careers.

Flight Lieutenant Jodie Boyd-Ewens, MNZM, and Warrant Officers Treena Brown, Ngatasha Mana and Peter “Buck” Rogers recently marked their achievement at a graduation ceremony at the <a class="link" href="https://nz.linkedin.com/company/the-air-force-museum-of-new-zealand?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" target="_self" data-tracking-control-name="organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" data-tracking-will-navigate>Air Force Museum of New Zealand</a> in Wigram, Christchurch.

For many aviators RNZAF Base Wigram was known as the “home of New Zealand military aviation” and where much of our Air Force’s support and technical trade and flying training took place prior to the base’s closure in 1995.

Since 2020, graduates of the NZDF and RNZAF Joint Warrant Officers Advanced Course have been able to enrol into the Bachelor of Applied Management with 240 credits, leaving just six papers left to complete, to be awarded the degree.

“Balancing part-time study with full-time work as well as juggling postings and family commitments along the way wasn’t always easy, but it made achieving the degree even more rewarding." ~ Warrant Officer Treena Brown

Full story ➡️ <a class="link" href="http://nzdf.mil.nz/RNZAF-BAppMgt?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" target="_self" rel="nofollow" data-tracking-control-name="organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" data-tracking-will-navigate>nzdf.mil.nz/RNZAF-BAppMgt</a></p>

    <p class="attributed-text-segment-list__content text-color-text !text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap break-words
        " dir="ltr" data-test-id="main-feed-activity-card__commentary">This week, HMNZS Aotearoa worked with <a class="link" href="https://ca.linkedin.com/company/royalcanadiannavy?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" target="_self" data-tracking-control-name="organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" data-tracking-will-navigate>Royal Canadian Navy | Marine royale canadienne</a> frigate HMCS Regina’s embarked helo during the sea phase of RIMPAC 26.  

Callsign Bronco, the CH-148 Cyclone helicopter, conducted a series of challenging vertical replenishments with a flight deck party from Aotearoa. 
 
Vertical replenishments (VERTREP) are a method of logistics supply where a helicopter hovers above a vessel’s flight deck. When delivering cargo, the helicopter descends until the load is on the deck and the flight deck party then detach the rigid cargo hook from the underside of the helicopter. When collecting cargo, this process is just reversed. 
 
Vertical replenishment is a complex cargo transfer manoeuvre that demands exceptional flying skills, good communications and highly synchronised teamwork between aircrew and ship personnel.
 
With a maximum takeoff weight of just over 13,000kg, the Cyclone is twice as heavy as one of our Seasprite helicopters, so while it couldn’t land on Aotearoa, it was a great opportunity for the ship’s company to conduct this type of specialist logistics training. 
 
The <a class="link" href="https://ca.linkedin.com/company/canadianforces-forcescanada?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" target="_self" data-tracking-control-name="organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" data-tracking-will-navigate>Canadian Armed Forces | Forces armées canadiennes</a> are a close friend of our Defence Force and are one of the 30 nations we’re interacting with at RIMPAC – the world’s largest maritime warfare exercise.

        " dir="ltr" data-test-id="main-feed-activity-card__commentary">The future starts here 📍 We recently welcomed an incredible group of young people from all over New Zealand to the School to Skies camp at RNZAF Base Auckland, where they spent five days experiencing firsthand how STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) powers the Royal New Zealand Air Force.
 
From aircraft maintenance and mission planning to physical training, leadership challenges, industry engagement sessions, Communications and Information Systems training, and stepping aboard a C-130J Hercules aircraft, students were immersed in the world of aviation and defence. 

Along the way, they pushed themselves outside their comfort zones, built confidence, made connections, developed new skills, and explored the diverse career opportunities available within our Air Force.

School to Skies is about opening doors, breaking down barriers, and inspiring the next generation of engineers, technicians, pilots, and aviation professionals.
